create_sift_detector: create a SIFT detector instance with a given device for keypoint detection
run_sift_keypoint_detection: run SIFT detection on a batch of torch tensor images and return keypoints and descriptors
build_sift_descriptors: build SIFT descriptors from normalized torch tensor images on a specified device
test_sift_keypoint_format: test that SIFT keypoints are returned in yx coordinate order as torch tensors
review_sift_matcher: review the SIFT module's matcher configured with L2 distance and mutual nearest neighbor matching
